title: Collection Pricing Terms for Northgate Special Orders: Savings Withheld on a Changed-Mind Refund
content:
Northgate Special Order merchandise sold as part of a collection is priced on the expectation that the collection stays together. These Northgate Purchases & Returns pricing terms state what part of that saving is withheld when a member returns pieces for a changed mind and keeps the rest.

## Collection savings withheld from the changed-mind refund

When, after this refund, two or more units of the same merchandise class remain kept on the purchase and the purchase's sales of that class total 3000.00 or more, 6 percent of the returned value is withheld; when exactly one unit of that class remains kept and the class sales total 1500.00 or more, or two or more remain kept and the class sales total at least 1500.00 but less than 3000.00, 4 percent is withheld; otherwise no collection savings are withheld.

- **The class** is the merchandise class of the sale line on the received return authorization.
- **Units remaining kept after this refund** are the units of that class sold on the purchase, less the units of that class already refunded on the purchase, less the units on the received authorization.
- **The class sales** are the line amounts of every sale line of that class on the purchase, added together as sold.
- **The returned value** is the units on the received authorization multiplied by the sale line's unit price.
- Every percentage point withheld from the returned value forms one percentage, applied once to the returned value; the amount withheld is rounded half up to the cent and subtracted from the returned value.

## Combinations

| Units of the class kept after this refund | Class sales (USD) | Withheld |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | 3000.00 or more | 6 percent |
| 2 or more | 1500.00 to under 3000.00 | 4 percent |
| exactly 1 | 1500.00 or more | 4 percent |
| 1 or more | under 1500.00 | none |
| none | any | none |

## Worked case (hypothetical purchase)

A purchase sold 4 recliners in class mattress and furniture at 900.00 each, class sales 3600.00; none refunded before; the received authorization covers 1 recliner. Kept after this refund: 4 less 0 less 1, that is 3. The 6 percent band applies: 6 percent of the returned value of 900.00 is 54.00 withheld.

Had the purchase sold 2 recliners at 800.00 (class sales 1600.00), returning 1 would leave exactly 1 kept: 4 percent of 800.00, 32.00, withheld.
